text.大手建設会社のマンションインテリア専門部門として設立: Founded as the apartment interiors division of a major construction company
text.現所在地（目黒区青葉台）に部門を移転: The division moved to its present address in Aobadai, Meguro
text.都心のマンションでありながら心地よく暮らすために、漆喰や無垢の木材などの自然素材: Began developing interior design using natural materials — lime plaster, solid timber — so that a city apartment could be comfortable to live in
text.自然素材で創るマンションのデザインリフォーム専門会社を設立: Established a company dedicated to design-led apartment renovation in natural materials
text.「TIMELESS LIVING ─今も未来も心地よい暮らし─」をコンセプトに、: Under the idea “TIMELESS LIVING — a home that is comfortable now and in years to come”, began renovating and selling flats in vintage blocks such as Hiroo Garden Hills and Pair City
text.「TIMELESS LIVING」を商標登録: Registered TIMELESS LIVING as a trade mark
text.個人向けマンションリフォーム事業会社として「株式会社タイムレスリビング」を設立: Established Timeless Living Co., Ltd. as a company renovating apartments for private clients

description: From an apartment interiors division in 2003 to Timeless Living Co., Ltd. in 2010: the dated record of how the practice came to build in natural materials.
